customManagers.description: Track the tools that lint.yml installs by version: actionlint (github-releases) and zizmor (pypi). Each pin carries a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above its `<NAME>_VERSION:` env value, so one pattern covers both. github-actions never reads these env values.

packageRules.description: Hold every claude-code-action bump for review. Every caller's `@claude review` runs this action on the oauth path, and the hardening (exact allow rules, guard hook, Read denies) depends on its tag-mode tool list and on the CLI version it pins. Before merging, read src/modes/tag/index.ts at the new version and re-run the headless guard and symlink tests.

Hold every Claude Code bump of the `auth: api` path (.github/claude-review/package.json and its lockfile) for review, for the same reason as claude-code-action: the guard hook, the allow rules and the setting-sources isolation must still hold on the new CLI.

Hold actionlint bumps. lint.yml pins ACTIONLINT_SHA256 next to the version, and this repo has no task that refreshes it, so a bump fails the actionlint job's `sha256sum -c` until a person updates the hash in the same PR.
